proposals.title: Lead proposal review
proposals.description: Candidates proposed by agents. Nothing enters the CRM until a person accepts it.
proposals.emptyDescription: Agent-proposed candidates and their evidence appear here.
proposals.noEvidence: No evidence — verify the source before accepting

decision.acceptDescription: Accepting registers the company in the CRM. Email addresses in the proposal are not sendable until a send basis is confirmed.
decision.rejectDescription: You may leave a reason. Rejected proposals can be proposed again.
decision.conflict: Someone else already handled this proposal. Refresh the list and review the latest state.
decision.forbidden: You do not have permission to review this proposal.
decision.versionPrecondition: A version check is required. Refresh the list and try again.

proposals.unverifiedEmailNote: Emails in this proposal start with a pending communication basis even when a source was observed. Addresses generated from name patterns are not allowed.

evidence.title: Research evidence
evidence.confidenceNote: Model confidence does not substitute for human verification
evidence.reviewDescription: Check the source and observation time before deciding. This decision does not create a send basis by itself.
evidence.forbidden: You do not have permission to review evidence.

panel.title: Research evidence
panel.description: Review source, observation time, and review status of AI-completed fields. Unsourced claims are unverified.
